title: TrajectorySimulateRequest
description: Earth->Moon transfer and powered descent to a lunar site, computed by the vecteur-traj tool (POST /trajectory/simulate). Engineering demonstration for the 3D views, not a mission design.

altitude_km.description: Site height above the 1737.4 km reference sphere (spherical ground).

departure_utc.description: Departure from the 200 km Earth parking orbit, UTC ISO 8601 with a literal 'Z'.

transfer_days.description: Target transfer duration; the tool searches within +/- 2 days of it.
